subject: Fermi GBM trigger 804010507/260624677 is not a GRB
body:
R. Hamburg (USRA) reports report on behalf of the Fermi Gamma-ray Burst Monitor Team:

"The Fermi Gamma-ray Burst Monitor (GBM) trigger 804010507/260624677 at 16:15:02.91 UT on 24 June 2026, tentatively classified as a GRB, is in fact not due to a GRB. This trigger is likely due to particle activity."
